Effect: [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's 6000 DP or lower Digimon. If this Digimon has a red Tamer card in its digivolution cards, delete 1 of your their Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon’s DP instead.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 [Takuya Kanbara] from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
